status_note: Public prototype. Maturity labels are provisional, not verified production status.

capabilities.name: Manage Property Information & Knowledge
capabilities.description: Maintain structured information and contextual knowledge about each property, including its characteristics, spaces and relevant history.

capabilities.name: Manage Property Inventory
capabilities.description: Register and manage property-specific equipment and assets, associating each inventory item with an equipment type and a property area to support operational activities.

capabilities.name: Manage Property Media
capabilities.description: Organize and maintain property images, renditions and multilingual descriptive metadata.

capabilities.name: Manage Consumables
capabilities.description: Define, track and replenish consumable supplies required for property operations and guest stays.

capabilities.name: Manage Property Amenities
capabilities.description: Maintain a guest-oriented representation of property amenities, drawing on equipment and consumables to support accurate listings and guest communications.

capabilities.name: Manage Property Documents
capabilities.description: Organize, classify and monitor property-related documents, including their validity and compliance requirements.

capabilities.name: Manage Traveler Relationships
capabilities.description: Maintain traveler profiles, contact information and stay history to support personalized hospitality and ongoing guest relationships.

capabilities.name: Manage Enquiries & Reservations
capabilities.description: Manage booking enquiries, reservations, commercial details and booking status throughout the reservation lifecycle.

capabilities.name: Manage Guest Journey
capabilities.description: Support and coordinate the guest experience across pre-arrival, in-stay and post-stay interactions, maintaining continuity and relevant context throughout the journey.

capabilities.name: Understand Guest Feedback
capabilities.description: Collect, interpret and analyze guest feedback to understand experiences, identify recurring themes and support service improvements.

capabilities.name: Manage Property Maintenance
capabilities.description: Plan, assign, track and document maintenance activities across properties, equipment and service providers.

capabilities.name: Manage Cleaning & Preparation
capabilities.description: Schedule, coordinate and monitor cleaning and property preparation activities, including turnovers and intermediate services.

capabilities.name: Manage Service Providers
capabilities.description: Maintain service provider information, specializations and relationships, linking providers to operational activities and service history.

capabilities.name: Manage Operational Observations
capabilities.description: Capture, classify and follow up operational observations, transforming identified issues, quality risks and improvement ideas into actionable outcomes.

capabilities.name: Manage Property Stakeholder Relations
capabilities.description: Coordinate property-related interactions, issues and actions involving condominium administrations, neighbors and other local stakeholders.

capabilities.name: Manage Financial Transactions
capabilities.description: Record, classify and reconcile property-related revenues, expenses, payments and financial transactions.

capabilities.name: Manage Owner Accounts & Balances
capabilities.description: Maintain owner financial accounts, tracking property revenues, expenses, commissions, payments and outstanding balances.

capabilities.name: Manage Fiscal & Regulatory Obligations
capabilities.description: Calculate, monitor and support property-related fiscal and regulatory reporting obligations, including tourist taxes and statutory declarations.

capabilities.name: Manage Pricing & Commercial Strategy
capabilities.description: Define and manage pricing policies, distribution strategies and commercial decisions to optimize occupancy, revenue and property positioning.

capabilities.name: Analyze Business Performance
capabilities.description: Analyze property revenue, occupancy, booking patterns, guest segments and financial performance to support management decisions.
